zombie-outbreak.title: Zombie Outbreak Survival Guide
zombie-outbreak.description: When the undead rise, be ready!
items: Secure a safe house (high ground, single entry point)
Stockpile non-perishable food and water (3 months supply)
Gather essential tools (axe, crowbar, duct tape)
Learn basic first aid and wound care
Establish communication plan with survivors
Practice silent movement and evasion techniques
Identify escape routes and fallback locations

ai-uprising.title: AI Uprising Countermeasures
items: Unplug non-essential smart devices
Learn basic electronics and circuit disruption
Develop analog communication methods (radio, signal fires)
Stockpile EMP-resistant electronics (faraday cage)
Practice stealth and camouflage against drone surveillance
Understand basic hacking and network disruption (offline)
Form alliances with other human resistance cells

meteor-impact.title: Meteor Impact Fallout Protocol
meteor-impact.description: When the sky falls, survive the aftermath!
items: Identify sturdy underground shelter
Stockpile radiation-proof containers for water/food
Gather air filtration masks and protective clothing
Learn basic geology and seismic safety
Prepare for long-term darkness and cold
Develop skills for foraging and hunting in harsh environments
Establish a system for debris removal and structural reinforcement

alien-invasion.title: Alien Invasion Defense Strategy
alien-invasion.description: They came, they saw, they... didn't conquer us!
items: Study alien weaknesses (if any known)
Prepare for electromagnetic interference
Develop guerrilla warfare tactics
Stockpile non-native food sources (they might not like our food)
Learn basic xenolinguistics (just in case)
Identify potential alien collaborators (and avoid them)
Establish a global resistance network (if possible)
